removed.what: the altChunk (word/afchunk.html, an HTML part) is replaced by 2 ordinary paragraphs with the same text
removed.why: an altChunk asks the consumer to import foreign HTML; most browser editors drop or reject it

removed.what: the OLE-embedded document (word/embeddings/embedded1.docx) is replaced by the icon picture Word shows for it
removed.why: an embedded OLE package is an opaque binary a browser editor cannot open

removed.what: the enforced read-only lock (w:documentProtection w:edit="readOnly" in word/settings.xml) is lifted
removed.why: an editor that honours the lock, as Word does, would not let a visitor type in the demo
